description: Features from the payments an applicant made on earlier Home Credit loans, one row per applicant. Built in notebooks/07_installments_eda_features.ipynb.

not_used.POS_CASH_balance.csv, credit_card_balanc: Out of scope for this table. Both passed the supply test in notebook 05 and are for later notebooks.
not_used.previous_application.csv: Used in the notebook to interpret the rows (loan type, planned payments, end dates). No feature in this table reads it.

INST_N_INSTALMENTS.definition: Instalments on record for loans with a fixed schedule (cash and consumer loans), not counting penalty charges.

INST_DAYS_SINCE_LAST_PAYMENT.definition: Days from the most recent payment to the current application.

INST_N_PAYMENTS_30D.definition: Instalments, of any kind, whose last payment was made in the 30 days before the application.

INST_SHARE_LATE_5D.definition: Share of schedule instalments completed more than 5 days after the due date.

INST_MAX_DAYS_LATE.definition: The longest delay on any paid schedule instalment, in days. Zero if none was late.

INST_N_LATE_30D.definition: Schedule instalments completed more than 30 days late, among those that fell due more than 30 days before the application.

INST_MEAN_DAYS_EARLY.definition: Average number of days paid before the due date over paid schedule instalments, with a late payment counted as zero, capped at 60.

INST_SHARE_LATE_5D_12M.definition: Share completed more than 5 days late, among schedule instalments due in the 365 days before the application.

INST_MEAN_TIMING_12M.definition: Average of completion date minus due date, in days (negative is early), each capped at 60 either way, over paid schedule instalments due in the last 365 days.

INST_TIMING_CHANGE.definition: MEAN_TIMING_12M minus the same average over earlier instalments. Positive means paying later than before.

INST_N_LATE_5D_6M.definition: Schedule instalments due in the last 183 days and completed more than 5 days late.
INST_N_LATE_5D_6M.warning: Differs between train and test (stage 8, rule 1): keep with a warning: recent late payment is rarer among test applicants, while the columns are filled in equally often in both files. Report the model with and without it.

INST_DAYS_SINCE_LAST_LATE_5D.definition: Days since a schedule instalment last fell due that was completed more than 5 days late. Missing if none ever was.

INST_LAST_TIMING.definition: Completion date minus due date for the schedule instalment with the latest due date. Missing if it has no payment.

INST_SHARE_PAID_IN_PARTS.definition: Share of schedule instalments paid in more than one payment.

INST_SHARE_PAID_IN_PARTS_12M.definition: The same, among schedule instalments due in the last 365 days.

INST_N_SHORT.definition: Schedule instalments that were paid, but for less than was due.

INST_N_UNPAID_RECENT.definition: Instalments of 200 or more with no payment on record, due within 30 days of the application. Penalty charges are not counted.
INST_N_UNPAID_RECENT.warning: Differs between train and test (stage 8, rule 1): keep with a warning: a recent unpaid instalment is rarer among test applicants, while the columns are filled in equally often in both files. Report the model with and without it.

INST_N_UNPAID_OLDER.definition: The same, due more than 30 days before the application.

INST_N_PENALTIES.definition: Rows numbered above 100 on loans other than cards, read as charges raised after a late payment.

INST_N_PENALTIES_24M.definition: Penalty charges that fell due in the 730 days before the application.

INST_DAYS_SINCE_LAST_PENALTY.definition: Days since the most recent penalty charge fell due. Missing if there is none.

INST_CARD_N_INSTALMENTS.definition: Instalments on record for credit cards (loans with calendar version 0).

INST_CARD_SHARE_LATE_5D.definition: Share of card instalments completed more than 5 days late.

INST_CARD_ACTIVE_90D.definition: 1 if a card instalment fell due in the 90 days before the application, otherwise 0.

INST_CARD_MEAN_PAYMENT_12M.definition: Average amount paid per card instalment due in the last 365 days.

INST_PAID_12M.definition: Total paid on schedule instalments due in the last 365 days.

INST_MEDIAN_AMT_DUE.definition: Median amount due per schedule instalment.

INST_SHARE_LOANS_LARGE_PAYMENT.definition: Share of schedule loans that include an instalment more than three times that loan's median: an early repayment of the balance.

INST_SHARE_SPLIT_DUE.definition: Share of schedule instalments whose amount due is written in parts under more than one calendar version.

INST_N_LOANS.definition: Loans with a payment on record, of any kind. 0 when there is no payment history.

INST_DAYS_SINCE_FIRST_DUE.definition: Days from the earliest due date on record to the current application. The record stops at eight years.

INST_SHARE_LATE.definition: Share of schedule instalments completed after the due date.

INST_MEAN_DAYS_LATE.definition: Average delay over paid schedule instalments, with an on-time payment counted as zero and each delay capped at 60 days.

cleaning_rules: A payment of zero is treated as no payment.
A row with no payment is dropped when the same instalment, in the same calendar version, has a payment on another row.
A loan is a card if any of its rows has calendar version 0.
On loans other than cards, rows numbered above 100 are penalty charges, kept apart from the schedule.
Within an instalment, the amount due is summed over calendar versions and the amount paid is taken from one.
unit: One instalment is one loan and instalment number. Lateness is the date the instalment was completed minus its due date.
most_recent_rule: The latest due date, with ties broken by the higher SK_ID_PREV and then the higher instalment number.
limits: A row exists only when both its dates are before the application, so the last few weeks before it are incompletely recorded (stage 4).
A delay cannot be recorded as longer than the time between the due date and the application.
An instalment that fell due and was not paid usually has no row at all. The unpaid counts see only the few that do.
The reading of rows numbered above 100 as penalty charges rests on their pattern, not on the data dictionary.
properties_verified: Each applicant's features depend on that applicant's rows only (section 7.4).
No function uses the target, and none contains a number estimated from the data.
An independent rebuild of 540 applicants from the raw rows agrees on all 33 features (section 7.2).
No due date and no payment date is on or after the current application (stage 4).
Fifteen facts about the table pass the train-test supply test (section 3.6).
selection_note: No feature was dropped using outcomes. Four were dropped as near-copies. The holdout was not used.
